issues.title: Checkout manifest remains mutable installation authority
issues.details: install.sh copies the manifest and source files from the same runner-controlled workspace, so an attacker can replace both before capture and pass the captured digest check.

issues.title: External GitHub API evidence is declared but never verified
issues.details: The workflow asserts and prints endpoint strings but proves neither runner 6252 nor group 6 membership nor the exact selected-workflow restriction.

issues.title: Full verifier is absent from protected and generated-root gates
issues.details: Schema-only validation and shell checks do not exercise exact package inventory, systemd bytes/state, workspace, sudo policy, or adversarial filesystem behavior.

issues.title: Capability ledger mutates before no-follow validation
issues.details: A pre-existing symlink at the ledger root can receive root chown/chmod before the later no-follow open rejects it.
